fee_notes: Single full/counter/line service Restaurant: $35,000 nonrefundable. Add-on ghost kitchen/cloud kitchen: $10,000. 20% discount for eligible military or 501(c)(3) organizations. During fiscal 2025, Famous Dave's collected $0 to $65,000 from franchisees for Initial Fees.
raw_excerpt: If you sign a Franchise Agreement for a single Restaurant that offers full service, counter service or line service (as apart of full service), you must pay Famous Dave's a nonrefundable Initial Fee of $35,000 depending on the service model. If you sign a Franchise Agreement for a single add-on ghost kitchen or cloud kitchen Restaurant, you must pay Famous Dave's a nonrefundable Initial Fee of $10,000.
